login.subtitle: Enter your password to access the dashboard
login.title: SiftGate
identity.storyTitle: A clear way into your AI operations.
identity.storyCopy: Connect your models, govern access and keep everyday operations in your hands.
identity.localNotice: Administrator access is separate from your model API keys.
identity.activateCopy: Use the one-time code from this installation and choose your administrator password.
identity.recoverCopy: A server operator must issue a recovery code. Recovery does not change your gateway keys or business data.
identity.codeHint: Single use. Valid for 15 minutes. Never share it in a support ticket.
identity.policy: Use at least 15 characters and no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes. A long passphrase works well.
identity.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
identity.revokeNotice: Confirm your current password. All Dashboard sessions will be signed out; gateway API keys stay valid.
identity.success: Access is ready. Sign in with your new password.
identity.addressHelp: First, check the instance address above. Different installations have different credentials.
identity.managedHelp: On the server, the installation owner can issue a new code. The command returns the private file path, not the code.
identity.legacyHelp: Use the password configured by your administrator or your company SSO. For an older customer-kit installation, its initial password may be in the file below. Recovery and password changes use the existing administrator procedure.
identity.pathHelp: These commands assume the default installation directory. Replace it if yours is different; never initialize over an existing installation.
identity.secretNotice: Never send passwords or access codes to chat, email or support tickets.
identity.expired: This activation code has expired. Ask the installation owner to issue a new code using the help below.
identity.invalidCode: This code is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new code for this instance.
identity.conflict: Access settings changed during this operation. Refresh before trying again.
identity.unavailable: Unable to complete this request. Check connectivity or contact the installation administrator.
identity.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
identity.ssoError: Company sign-in did not complete. Try again or contact your identity administrator.
identity.noRestart: Access changes do not restart model traffic.
